title: NVIDIA 宣布收购 Hugging Face，黄仁勋与纳德拉表态开放模型生态
content:
正文 · AI 翻译
期待这一生态系统随着开放模型与 NVIDIA 和 Hugging Face 的持续合作而不断繁荣发展。祝贺 @JensenHuang 和 @ClementDelangue！
对 NVIDIA 和 @huggingface 来说是激动人心的一天。 开放模型能增强安全性与网络安全，加速创新与扩散，并实现主权自主。它们让每一位开发者、每一家初创公司、每一所大学、每一个行业和每一个国家都能基于 AI 进行构建、定制并从中受益。 感谢 @ClementDelangue 亲自前来与我交流。 NVIDI...

report.summary: NVIDIA announces Hugging Face acquisition; Nadella and Huang tout open models, signaling a major open-ecosystem shift in AI.
report.background: Hugging Face has become the de facto hub for open-source AI models, datasets, and the Transformers library, serving millions of developers. NVIDIA, the dominant AI chipmaker, has been expanding beyond hardware into software stacks, developer platforms, and enterprise AI services. Acquiring Hugging Face lets NVIDIA couple its compute infrastructure with the largest community distribution point for AI models. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella‘s public endorsement reinforces the strategic importance of open weights, emphasizing security, innovation, and sovereign AI autonomy. The acquisition reflects a broader industry battle between closed proprietary systems and open-model ecosystems, with governments and enterprises increasingly seeking self-hosted AI.
key_points: NVIDIA is acquiring Hugging Face, putting the leading model repository and developer community under its control and creating a vertically integrated AI platform from chips to model distribution.
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella praised the deal, arguing that open models improve security, speed up innovation, and make AI sovereignty achievable for countries and organizations.
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang framed the partnership as a commitment to openness, saying developers, startups, universities, and governments can build, customize, and benefit from AI on open foundations.

Hugging Face CEO Clement Delangue is reportedly on board, aligning his community-first vision with NVIDIA’s infrastructure-led strategy, likely deepening integration between Transformers and CUDA-based accelerators.
The deal signals a shift in AI monetization: hardware vendors may increasingly compete by owning the open model ecosystem rather than selling access to proprietary APIs.
report.impact: For the AI industry, the acquisition solidifies NVIDIA’s influence across both training and deployment, potentially making Hugging Face hubs more deeply optimized for NVIDIA GPUs and enterprise stacks like NeMo. Developers may benefit from seamless model deployment, but could face indirect lock-in as community tools become increasingly aligned with NVIDIA’s commercial interests. For regular users, the deal may accelerate region-specific and industry-specific open models suited for privacy-sensitive applications as sovereign AI becomes mainstream. At the same time, competitors like AMD and open-source purists will watch closely, and regulators may scrutinize whether one company controlling compute and model distribution harms market fairness.
report.tools: Watch Hugging Face Transformers and Hub as primary integration points. NVIDIA’s open-source NeMo, NVIDIA AI Enterprise, and Optimum-NVIDIA will likely bridge models to GPUs and custom CUDA tooling. vLLM remains a useful open-source serving engine for open-weight models, while Hugging Face’s own container and Inference Endpoints suite offers practical deployment options.
